title: Aerobic + strides before the Bucharest flight
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 06:45 start. 55min at 142-152bpm, then 6x20s strides, 40s easy. Done by 07:50 for the 08:00 call.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water. Light dinner before BGY (21:45 flight), no alcohol.
GARMIN: ~65-80.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 = 40min easy, no strides.
WHY: the week's only normal night is Sunday, so Monday carries load instead of the usual rest.
